summary.text: Heaven and Earth Combined Strength is a killer move Chu Du chants in Hei Fan grotto-heaven.

claims.text: Inside Hei Fan grotto-heaven, Chu Du faces Heavenly Lord Bai Zu’s clones and refuses to fight at the enemy’s tempo. After battle strength transpiration, he raises his right hand to the sky palm up and his left hand facing the ground, then chants the name. The three clones cannot move. They feel like the entire world is sending unparalleled strength that restricts them, crushing toward them from all directions. Chu Du is strained as well. His muscles tense, he uses all of his strength, and his two arms converge toward the center with great difficulty. The force around the clones increases until they are almost crushed. At the crucial moment, the fourth, fifth, and sixth clones come to save them. The first clone and second clone are smashed. The third clone is saved and calls it an amazing killer move that can attack, defend, and immobilize multiple targets, almost like an incomplete battlefield killer move.

Pinned by Hei Lou Lan and the dark capital strength biao, Chu Du slams the biao down with a strength path giant hand. After battle strength transpiration, an immortal killer move is named heaven and earth combined strength. Chu Du straightens both arms and claps them together in front of his chest. The surrounding thousand li are enveloped by a formless force. Gu Immortals are restrained and unable to move easily. Affected by this killer move, the dark capital strength biao’s speed falls drastically and its threat plunges. Hei Lou Lan calls it a quasi-battlefield killer move. The observing immortals retreat at once and leave the range of heaven and earth combined strength.
